output.review_comment: The pull request correctly fixes all issues in the original code. The changes add required validation for edge cases (negative desks, empty/zero headcounts), ensure all teams appear in the result dict (including those with zero desks), and improve the allocation algorithm with exact rational arithmetic using Fraction and explicit tie-breaking logic. The implementation properly follows the D'Hondt method as specified in the docstring. All test cases should pass with these changes.
